title: Geologic Map of the Calabash Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2016, Geologic Map of the Calabash Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-220, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR map sheet. Map face (lines with coordinates and place names) is garbled and gave no values. Map symbols are placed by OCR after the description they sit beside; each symbol-to-unit association is flagged inferred. Symbols for the Ten Mile Hill and Ladson units and for the freshwater marsh and Carolina bay deposits were not legible. Thicknesses OCR'd as '| to 12 feet' (freshwater marsh), '| to 6 feet' (Carolina bay deposits) and '| to 8 feet' (Princess Anne estuarine) were not recorded because the first digit is unreadable. Assignment of the estuarine deposits printed after the disclaimer to the Ten Mile Hill alloformation is inferred from text order. Drill-hole symbol (SCGS log numbers) gives no individual logs. Bodies of water unit skipped.
